name: Hintertuxer Gletscher
kurzbeschreibung: Austria's only year-round ski resort offers 365 days of snow sports up to 3,250 m, the Nature Ice Palace, and Spannagel Cave.
beschreibung:
Overview

The magnificent Hintertuxer Gletscher sits at the head of the Zillertal within the Tux Valley and is Austria's only year-round ski area, offering snow sports and high-alpine nature adventures up to 3,250 meters on 365 days a year. Surrounded by glaciated three-thousand-meter peaks such as the distinctive Olperer (3,476 m) and the Gefrorene Wand, the glacier's perennial ice forms a premier alpine arena. Visitors enter a frozen world of perpetual firn snow, deep-blue crevasses, and grand moraines. Beyond skiing, the massif harbors remarkable subterranean wonders deep beneath ice and rock: the accessible "Nature Ice Palace" directly beneath the ski slopes and the Spannagel Cave, the largest and highest cave system in the Central Eastern Alps.

Route & Requirements

The ascent into this high-alpine domain takes place in three modern cable car stages using the "Gletscherbus 1, 2, and 3" – renowned as some of the most wind-stable bicable gondolas in the world. In just minutes, visitors climb around 1,750 vertical meters from Hintertux valley station to the panoramic terrace at Gefrorene Wand at 3,250 meters. The observation deck is barrier-free and provides clear-day vistas stretching from the Dolomites to the Großglockner. At this extreme altitude, warm layered winter clothing, a windproof jacket, UV sunglasses, and sturdy shoes are mandatory even in midsummer. For guided tours into the Nature Ice Palace – featuring crystalline ice formations and a boat tour across a subglacial lake – or through Spannagel Cave, helmets and protective gear are provided. Good footing is required for underground tours.

Visit & Arrival

Cable cars and the panoramic viewing terrace are open daily year-round. Ascent tickets and guided tour bookings are available at the valley ticket desks in Hintertux or online. Motorists travel via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Zillertal), follow the B169 to Mayrhofen, and continue up the Tuxer Landesstraße to Hintertux (large parking garages available). Train travelers take the Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen and connect to the frequent Tuxer Sportbus directly to the lift base.

Tips

Book the unique stand-up paddle or inflatable raft tour on the subterranean glacier lake inside the Nature Ice Palace for a memorable experience at a steady zero degrees Celsius. Take a break at the Tuxer Fernerhaus panoramic restaurant for hearty regional specialties.
preis: Panorama ticket adults from approx. €45.00; guided cave and ice palace tours booked separately
oeffnungszeiten: Open 365 days a year daily from 08:15 to 16:30
